title: Trial by Trace
summary: A historical summary reports 3,420 evaluated runs across 95 tasks, four harnesses and nine models. Task achievement coincided with failure to meet harness-side criteria in 31.1% of runs.
limitations: The summary describes one selected execution for each condition and dependencies among evaluation items. These observations do not identify causal superiority among harnesses.
verification_scope: Preserved from a short dated research summary. The source body and underlying detailed primary review were not part of this migration input; no new primary verification or reproduction is claimed.
